scope: Every regular file recursively inside this own lane at sealing, including all copied inputs, frozen helpers, source payloads/text, plans, search response, hashchain/lock, every completed receipt and output, reports and frozen-after.json. No external path is traversed.
reason: Manifest cannot hash itself; sealing runner receipt/output materialize only after it computes and saves manifest. No other file excluded.
no_frozen_writes: Frozen inputs and helpers never modified; final verify before terminal seal.
